summary: Reviewed the module sections against their owning implementation and actual callers, including persisted state, authorization, failure, cancellation, recovery, and platform boundaries. Distinguishes shipped composition from retained interfaces, optional integrations, and proposals. Bounded MCP policy delta: reviewed secure-scheme filtering versus complete CSP source-expression validation and effective browser containment; routes to the current host design without upgrading ordinary tool availability to rendering qualification.
limits: Source review is complete for the documented module claims; it does not establish every application behavior, live provider/device outcomes, deployed services, power-loss safety or production performance. One coordinator test timed out; its failure is retained. Linked designs and historical evidence have separate review records.
